scope: Downloaded local logs, not live server state

units.actual_bytes: mean bytes per scene; six decimals as printed
units.latency: ms per scene after five timing warm-up calls; not controlled inter-job benchmark

notes: 48 completed evaluations. Historical baseline table of 12 conditions and codec-OFF reference are not included in these extracted records.
last_progress_n is 6991 for all evaluations; 6986 is timing calls after warm-up, not evaluated scene count.
Identical four-decimal printed quality metrics do not establish per-scene bit-exact equality.
Older train metadata is based on repository recipes and historical documentation; 17 latest train logs are separately extracted.
Gaussian underperformance is an observation under one training schedule and fixed median, not proof of a distribution-family limitation.
